claims.claim: NXP reported Q2 2026 revenue of $3.496 billion, up 19% year over year and 10% sequentially, with growth across all end markets and regions.
Management identified Software-Defined Vehicles and Physical AI as company-specific growth drivers and described Data Center as an additional emerging growth engine.

factors.name: physical-AI exposure
factors.basis: NXP's processing, connectivity and security portfolio is positioned across vehicles, factories and robots where edge intelligence is expanding.

factors.name: data-center adjacency
factors.basis: Management now identifies Data Center as an additional growth engine, broadening beyond traditional automotive/industrial exposure.

risks.risk: Management attribution of growth drivers is directional evidence, not proof that each theme will sustain current growth rates.

unknowns.unknown: Theme-level revenue contribution for Physical AI and Data Center is not separately quantified in this source.

claims.claim: Q2 2026 non-GAAP free cash flow was $791 million, or 22.6% of revenue, while NXP returned $360 million of capital during the quarter.
NXP guided Q3 2026 revenue to $3.65-$3.85 billion, implying 15%-21% year-over-year growth at the stated range.

factors.name: operating execution
factors.basis: Broad revenue growth and strong free cash flow provide current operating evidence rather than roadmap-only claims.

factors.name: expectation bar
factors.basis: Q3 guidance embeds continued double-digit growth, creating a measurable execution hurdle.

risks.risk: Semiconductor demand remains cyclical and guidance can be affected by automotive/industrial inventory, macro demand and customer concentration.

unknowns.unknown: Q3 actual results are not yet available and guidance must not be treated as achieved.
